entities.name: Karfell
entities.description: One of the ten realms of Kaldheim, a frigid realm of ruined fortresses inhabited by undead draugr.

entities.name: Draugr
entities.description: Zombies of Karfell who retain their intelligence and memories and are loyal to Narfi.

entities.name: Narfi
entities.description: The Last High King of Karfell, a lich-king ruling from the Port of Marn.

entities.name: Dead Marn
entities.description: Army of raiders maintained by King Narfi that pillages other realms.

entities.name: Brinebarrow
entities.description: Ancient treasure vaults of Karfell, a byword for great wealth.

entities.name: Port of Marn
entities.description: The greatest of the old cities, a fortified port where Narfi holds court.

entities.name: Haunted Edge
entities.description: Seawall protecting the Port of Marn, with thousands of skeletons entombed inside.

entities.name: Skybreen Mountains
entities.description: Blizzard-wracked range home to paranoid living barbarians.

entities.name: Chasm Beast
entities.description: Creature living in Karfell's frigid ocean.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: Event that gives the Dead Marn an opportunity to pillage other realms.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Transplanar pathway that gives the Dead Marn opportunity to raid.

events.summary: Whenever a Doomskar or Omenpath opens, the Dead Marn pillage other realms for treasure.
events.quote: the Dead Marn pillage other realms in search of more treasure

relations.quote: they give their allegiance to Narfi
King Narfi maintains an army of raiders known as the Dead Marn
The Port of Marn - the greatest of the old cities
Karfell is one of the ten realms of the plane of Kaldheim
